summary_1line: After Ravana’s death, Vibhishana mourns his fallen brother with vivid metaphors, while Rama counsels that a warrior slain in battle should not be lamented.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vibhishana stands grieving over Ravana’s विशाल body lying on the battlefield, the fallen crown glinting beside his brother’s outstretched arms.
A rain of celestial flowers falls from the sky onto Rama’s chariot as monkeys cheer and divine drums resound in the heavens.
Rama speaks calmly to the sorrowful Vibhishana beside Ravana’s corpse, the quiet battlefield stretching around them after the war’s end.
